title: Top-k expert routing: the router matrix, softmax, top-k and renormalization in one CUDA kernel
description: topk-router's rule and code (its reference) with Gemma 4's case in one kernel: route_fused takes the BF16 router inputs and the BF16 router matrix and returns each token's top experts and weights (the logits in FP32 sums, a softmax over all experts, the top by score with ties to the lower id, renormalized and scaled, times each expert's own scale) in one launch (gguf-projections' code/gguf_gemv.cu, route); capture-safe, a junk row of NaN still picking distinct experts with weight 0. Other rules, and select(logits), run topk-router's torch form.
